sections.label: SkillsFuture Credit misuse by training organisations
sections.summary: Some training organisations misused SkillsFuture Credit, were suspended, and their claims withheld; SSG will recover monies and reinstate credit if misuse is established.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education))
sentences.text: Since the launch of the SkillsFuture Credit in January 2016, there have been reports on the misuse of this credit by some training organisations.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education))
sentences.text: These organisations have been suspended and all their claims are being withheld.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education))
sentences.text: Due to ongoing investigations, I am unable to disclose more details about these cases and the amount of SkillsFuture Credit claims affected.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education))
sentences.text: Nonetheless, I assure Members that SSG will spare no efforts in recovering the disbursed monies and will reinstate the credit if misuse is established and if Singaporeans have been cheated of their SkillsFuture Credit.

sections.label: Nine suspended training organisations
sections.summary: Due to ongoing investigations, details of nine cases cannot be disclosed, but the nine training organisations were suspended immediately upon possible misuse of SkillsFuture Credit.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As we look at these nine cases, as I mentioned earlier, due to ongoing investigations, we are not at liberty to go into the details of these nine cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: But suffice to say, as I have mentioned earlier, that the nine training organisations have been suspended with immediate effect once we know that there is a possible misuse of SkillsFuture Credit.

sections.label: Penalties and recovery for SkillsFuture Credit misuse
sections.summary: Under section 58 of the SkillsFuture Singapore Act, false or misleading information when claiming SkillsFuture Credit carries a fine up to S$10,000 or 12 months' imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: For instance, under section 58 of the SkillsFuture Singapore Act, any person who provides false or misleading information to SSG when claiming the SkillsFuture Credit is liable to a fine of up to S$10,000 or imprisonment of up to 12 months, or both.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: SSG, if they establish that, indeed, there is misuse, we will recover the disbursed monies from the training organisation that has abused the SkillsFuture Credit and we will also withdraw SSG funding support, as well as delisting them from the SkillsFuture Credit directory.
